name: Saoirse Murphy
bio:
Saoirse Murphy's journey into motorsport security was somewhat unconventional. Starting as a Garda Síochána (Irish police officer) with a specialization in counter-terrorism, she was recruited by a private security firm contracted to oversee security at an Irish rally event. Her sharp eye for detail and proactive approach to risk assessment quickly impressed the motorsport organizers. 

Following that event, Saoirse transitioned into motorsport full-time, working her way up through various racing series, including Formula E and WEC. Now at Haas F1 Team, she prides herself on creating a secure environment that allows the team to focus on performance. Her flexible approach means she's always adapting security protocols to meet the ever-changing needs of a Formula 1 team, ensuring the safety of personnel and assets both trackside and at the factory.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Saoirse has a lean build and a determined look in her green eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down potential security vulnerabilities.
Has a habit of chewing on the end of her pen when deep in thought.
Insists on conducting a pre-event security sweep herself, regardless of how thorough the team's initial assessment was.
